title: PRD-20 synthetic risk input syntax

organizationRef.description: required; active permitted organization. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

siteScheduleRef.description: required; approved versioned site rows. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: SITE_SCHEDULE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

assetScheduleRef.description: required; approved values/interests by asset/site. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: ASSET_SCHEDULE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

occupancyCodes.description: required by site; 1–100 distinct mapped use codes. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: OCCUPANCY_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

totalDeclaredValue.description: required; exact sum validated against approved schedule. Sensitivity: financial. Error: SCHEDULE_TOTAL_MISMATCH. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

valuationBasisCode.description: required; contract-offered basis <= 60. Sensitivity: financial. Error: VALUATION_BASIS_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

riskSurveyRefs.description: conditional; site-bound current evidence. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: RISK_SURVEY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
